description: This is a Java interface file defining the LogNode interface, which specifies a method for logging messages with various levels of detail and an optional Throwable exception. It is part of the common logging utilities in an Android application.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging chain node that outputs log data, potentially to multiple targets or filter chains.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message including its priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
